36	def resolve_signal(signals: list[dict[str, object]], ref: str) -> dict[str, object] | None:
37	    lowered = ref.casefold()
38	    for signal in signals:
39	        values = [signal.get("id"), signal.get("source_display")]
40	        if any(isinstance(value, str) and value.casefold() == lowered for value in values):
41	            return signal

45	def render_source(signal: dict[str, object], artifact: dict[str, object] | None) -> str:
46	    display = str(signal.get("source_display") or "Source")
47	    freshness = str(signal.get("freshness") or "unknown")
48	    lines = ["Open source", "", display, f"Freshness: {freshness}"]
49	    if freshness == "stale":
50	        lines.append("Use as background only. Verify before relying.")
51	
52	    reason = unavailable_reason(signal, artifact)
53	    if reason is not None:
54	        lines.extend(["", "Source body unavailable.", f"Reason: {reason}"])

64	def unavailable_reason(signal: dict[str, object], artifact: dict[str, object] | None) -> str | None:
65	    policy = signal.get("policy") if isinstance(signal.get("policy"), dict) else {}

72	    if freshness == "blocked":
73	        return "This source is blocked by policy."
74	    if freshness == "unavailable":
75	        return "This source is unavailable with current access."
76	    if not policy.get("can_include_source_text"):
